title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation board and safety committee
summary: Loss-of-control researcher Paul Christiano joined the OpenAI Foundation board and its Safety and Security Committee, warning the industry is not on track.

title: Anthropic scenario: AI boom could cut labour's income share to 45%
summary: Anthropic modelled an extreme case where US GDP is 32% higher by 2030 while labour's share of income falls from about 60% to 45%.
reason: Scenario, not forecast; signal about distribution.

title: Massachusetts requires local approval and clean power for big data centers
summary: Executive Order 658 blocks state permits for data centres over 25MW unless they meet a state framework, cover clean-power costs and sign community-benefit agreements.

title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash open weights with 1M context
summary: DeepSeek posted an MIT-licensed 552B multimodal MoE model with 8B active parameters and a one-million-token context.

title: Suno v6 launches with licensed label catalogs and rightsholder payments
summary: Suno's new model was built with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe, and begins paying participating rightsholders.
